Deliberately does NOT extend @wellsfargo-starui/platform/tsconfig.consumer.json — that config maps @wellsfargo-starui/* onto the platform repo's packages/ tree, which would defeat the point of this track. Tarball apps must resolve through their own node_modules, exactly as an external Artifactory consumer does. Kept in sync with the platform repo's tsconfig.base.json.
